newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway expands four-month T-bill SS49 by NOK 4 bln.
newsitem.headline: Norway expands four-month T-bill SS49 by NOK 4 bln.

text.p: Norway's central bank, Norges Bank, said on Thursday the Finance Ministry was expanding the SS49 treasury bill by four billion crowns through an ordinary auction.
Final date for tenders was set at 0800 GMT on August 4.
Norges Bank announced the ad-hoc issue of the four-month T-bill on July 8. It was issued at 5.5 billion crowns with 500 million crowns reserved for the bank.
SS49 had a nominal interest rate of four percent and matures on November 17, 1997.
